UmbracoDefinition.description: Configuration container for all Umbraco products.

UmbracoStorageProvidersAzureBlobDefiniti.description: Configuration of Umbraco Storage Providers - Azure Blob Storage.

AzureBlobFileSystemOptions.description: The Azure Blob File System options.

ConnectionString.description: Gets or sets the storage account connection string.

ContainerName.description: Gets or sets the container name.

ContainerRootPath.description: Gets or sets the root path of the container.

VirtualPath.description: Gets or sets the virtual path.

AzureBlobFileSystemCacheOptions.description: In-memory cache settings applied to blob metadata lookups by the read-only file provider.

Enabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether blob metadata caching is enabled. Defaults to true.

HitDuration.description: Gets or sets how long a successful metadata lookup is cached. Defaults to 00:00:30.

MissDuration.description: Gets or sets how long a not-found metadata result is cached. Defaults to 00:00:05.

SizeLimit.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of cached entries. Defaults to 10000.
